_comment: Static fallback baseline. Used whenever live feeds fail, latency-out, or return malformed data. All prices USD unless noted.

benchmarks._mops97_note: ESTIMATED, not a real quoted benchmark we have a feed for -- linearly extrapolated from the mops92/mops95 spread (~0.93 USD/bbl per RON step) since Kepmen 245/2022 requires Gasoline 97 specifically for the RON98 bracket. Replace with a real MOPS/Argus Gasoline 97 quote when available.
benchmarks._mops_gasoil_cn51_note: ESTIMATED: mops_gasoil_usd_bbl (0.25% sulfur, CN48 bracket) plus a ~1.5% illustrative premium for the ultra-low-sulfur 0.005% grade (CN51 bracket) required for premium diesel (Dexlite, Pertamina Dex, and equivalent competitor premium diesel). Replace with a real quoted differential when available.

fx._note: Kepmen 245/2022 specifies a 2-month-lagged trailing AVERAGE JISDOR rate (25th of month-2 through 24th of month-1) as the official FX input, not spot. We use the single baseline/spot rate here -- a real implementation would need a daily JISDOR history to compute that trailing average.

esdm_formula.regulation: Kepmen ESDM No. 245.K/MG.01/MEM.M/2022 (amends Kepmen No. 62.K/12/MEM/2020) -- Formula Harga Dasar dalam Perhitungan Harga Jual Eceran Jenis BBM Umum Jenis Bensin dan Minyak Solar
esdm_formula.scope_note: Despite 'Umum' sounding generic, this Kepmen explicitly governs ALL retail operators selling non-subsidized fuel through 'Stasiun Pengisian Bahan Bakar Umum' -- Pertamina, Shell, BP-AKR, Vivo alike, not Pertamina-only. It covers the wholesale 'Harga Dasar Tertinggi' (highest base price) ceiling only; PPN and PBBKB are layered on top separately under different regulations (see tax_stack). It does NOT cover Pertalite/Solar Subsidi's subsidized-fuel compensation scheme (a separate BBM Penugasan/PSO regulation we have not sourced) -- applying this formula to those two is this engine's approximation for the underlying cost basis, not a verified reading of that separate scheme.
esdm_formula.formula_note: Harga Dasar Tertinggi = (MOPS_or_Argus_IDR_per_liter + Konstanta) / 0.9; Margin = (10/90) x (MOPS_IDR_per_liter + Konstanta). MOPS value is the selected grade's published USD/bbl times a RON/CN-specific percentage (see each fuel's mops_pct), converted to Rp/L via the official bbl_to_liter (159) and JISDOR.

tax_stack._ppn_note: 12% -- current general VAT rate applied to non-subsidized BBM (raised from 11% under UU HPP). Source: pajakku.com, checked 2026-08-26. Subsidized fuel (Solar Subsidi) is VAT-exempt per the same source -- engine.py should special-case this, not apply 12% to it.
tax_stack._pbbkb_note: 10% -- DKI Jakarta Perda No. 1/2024 rate for GENERAL (private) vehicles; public-transport fuel gets a 50% discount (5%). PBBKB is a PROVINCIAL tax that varies by region (typically 5-10%) -- this is a single-region placeholder (DKI Jakarta), not a national constant. A full implementation needs a per-province PBBKB table, which we do not have yet. DPP (tax base) for PBBKB is the pre-PPN value per the same source.
tax_stack._ordering_note: This engine applies PBBKB on the ESDM base price, then PPN on the PBBKB-inclusive subtotal. This ordering is our best-effort reading of the two DPP definitions found during research (PBBKB: 'nilai jual sebelum PPN'; PPN: 'harga jual eceran'), not verified against one unified implementing rule -- treat as a reasonable estimate, not a certified tax computation.

_fuels_comment: Illustrative baseline RETAIL prices (price_idr_liter), approximating known public price ranges as of write time -- NOT scraped live, treat as placeholder until replaced with a real Pertamina/MyPertamina/competitor price feed (fuel_price_scraper.py supplies live values at runtime; these are only the fallback). is_administered=true means government-set/subsidized (Pertalite, Solar Subsidi) -- excluded from margin/profit optimization by design. regulatory_class/mops_pct/mops_benchmark_key/konstanta_idr_liter feed the ESDM Harga Dasar formula (esdm_formula above) for the COST side -- independent of price_idr_liter, which is the observed retail/administered price. octane_class groups fuels that compete head-to-head across brands for the margin optimizer's competitor-ceiling logic. demand_elasticity and wtp_ceiling_multiplier are ILLUSTRATIVE ASSUMPTIONS (not measured from real consumer data).

solar_subsidi.label: Solar Subsidi
solar_subsidi._regulatory_note: Cost basis approximated via the BBM Umum CN48 formula -- Solar Subsidi's actual subsidy/kompensasi scheme is separate legislation (BBM Penugasan/PSO) we have not sourced. VAT-exempt per pajakku.com.

conversion._note: 159 is the official conversion per Kepmen 245/2022 (rounded); 158.987 is the more precise industry-standard figure. Using the official rounded value now for regulation-consistency.
